visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a clear beer glass with a graphic of a frog on a surfboard titled '2023 禧啤派對'. The background is a blurred outdoor market with people. The camera cuts to a young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white crochet-style top and jewelry, smiling brightly as she holds the filled glass. (2) A middle-aged man in a grey t-shirt and baseball cap pours a reddish beer at a stall. The scene shifts to an outdoor lawn where people sit on wooden benches. White tents and green trees are visible under bright, natural daylight. (3) A close-up shows the beer glass filled with amber liquid held against a waterfront background with a white bridge. The camera zooms in on a mouth taking a sip from the glass. Another shot displays a massive burger with meat, cheese, and purple cabbage held in a box. (4) Various items are presented: a pink 'Free Exchange' card, two brown glass beer bottles with event labels, and white and black t-shirts featuring the frog logo hanging on a rack. The setting is an open-air pedestrian area. (5) Multiple food stalls appear: 'Holycow Burger', '双黃南洋餐廰', and '炸皮蛋'. People in aprons and masks work behind counters. Close-ups feature a thick burger dripping with cheese, fried chicken pieces, and fried century eggs drizzled with dark sauce. (6) A woman in a black apron and gloves stir-fries a large pile of noodles on a flat metal griddle, using two spatulas. Steam rises from the food. A serving of noodles is lifted with chopsticks. (7) A skewer of glazed sweet potato fries is held up. The scene cuts to a female DJ with a high ponytail performing on a Pioneer DJ console under stage lighting. The video ends with a panoramic shot of a white bridge over water during a vibrant orange sunset, followed by a text overlay with event details.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for the '2023 Cheers Pier-2 Party' event in Kaohsiung. It utilizes a high-energy montage of craft beer, diverse international food stalls (burgers, fried chicken, noodles), and live entertainment to attract viewers to visit the festival during its limited three-day run. The synthesis of cheerful narration and vibrant sunset visuals creates an inviting, fun atmosphere for potential attendees.
